## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender, and skinny young woman who possesses luminous, serious gray eyes described as alluring as evening stars. Her nose features seven freckles, set against a pale face with cheeks reminiscent of everchanging roses. She is primarily known for her hair, which is classically described as red or auburn, though it has also been referred to as [Titian](../character/titian.md), glossy, long enough for a braid, and even once turned green. Over time, her hairstyle has ranged from short shingled hair and short silky curls to an unbraided torrent of brightness streaming behind her.

## Personality

Extremely talkative, highly imaginative, and prone to daydreaming, this individual possesses a heedless and impulsive nature alongside a remarkable quickness to learn. Driven by strong ambitions, her early motivations center on achieving high examination results to surpass a rival and make her guardians proud, aiming to follow in the footsteps of a beloved teacher. She harbors a deep desire to be loved by everyone, striving to bring joy to others and add beauty to life, while harboring a specific dread of a haunted wood after dark. A talented reciter who excels at handling children, her aspirations expand to pursuing fame through writing short stories, winning the Avery scholarship, and attending college. Later, she dedicates herself to securing the Thorburn Scholarship in English to ensure she can continue her college studies without burdening her guardian's savings.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) as an orphan girl, Anne Shirley was raised by hand by Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) before living with Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) for over two years. Upon arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she was taken in by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) after an initial mix-up. She formed an immediate lifelong friendship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and developed a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after breaking a slate over his head at school. After attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and forfeiting her [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) scholarship to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following Matthew's death, she taught at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school and helped found the local [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). She also took in the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). During this time, Anne accidentally colored her nose bright red with dye and broke through a duck house roof while trying to buy a replacement willow-ware platter. She later attended [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), living at Patty's Place with friends and earning a thousand-dollar legacy from Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md). While at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Anne rejected marriage proposals from both [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and the wealthy [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), though she later realized her true feelings and accepted Gilbert's proposal in Hester Gray's garden.

## Quotes

> "You would cry, too, if you were an orphan and had come to a place you thought was going to be home and found that they didn’t want you because you weren’t a boy. Oh, this is the most tragical thing that ever happened to me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011)

> "but, oh, please do call me Cordelia. It can’t matter much to you what you call me if I’m only going to be here a little while, can it? And Anne is such an unromantic name."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)

> "why didn’t you tell me at the station that you didn’t want me and leave me there? If I hadn’t seen the White Way of Delight and the Lake of Shining Waters it wouldn’t be so hard."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0025)

> "She brought Lily Jones for herself. Lily is only five years old and she is very beautiful and had nut-brown hair. If I was very beautiful and had nut-brown hair would you keep me?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029)

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Anne and Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) are warm acquaintances in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their connection began on a humorous note when Anne accidentally flavored a cake for Mr. and Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) with anodyne liniment, though the couple treated the mistake with grace. Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) remains a supportive figure who approves of Anne's endeavors.

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's most devoted bosom friend and lifelong playmate. Their bond was forged through an oath of eternal friendship in the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) garden and survived an early crisis when Anne accidentally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk on currant wine. ### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Anne's relationship evolved from a intense academic rivalry into a close, comfortable friendship. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) famously pulled her hair and called her "Carrots" in school, Anne held a years-long grudge, even after he rescued her from a leaking boat on the pond. They eventually reconciled to become supportive study partners and fellow teachers, though tension resurfaced when Anne rejected his romantic proposal at college to preserve their friendship.
